number_of_samples: SDS-PAGE, immunoblots and high-resolution mass spectrometric analysis was performed with 16 house dust mite (HDM) SPT solutions and AVs from 3 Indian manufacturers.
technology_type: Desalted peptides resulting from the tryptic digests were separated by reverse-phase nano-HPLC (Dionex ultimate 3000, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany), directly coupled via nano electrospray to a Q Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
